content.rendered:
You are welcome to join us for kindergarten open house at Middleton Elementary, March 3, any time from 3:30-5:30. During this time you will get a school tour and your student will spend some time in a kindergarten classroom with the teachers while the parents meet next door with the principal for an overview of what to expect next year in kindergarten. There will also be time for questions after the overview. Your student will be also be able to participate in a few fun activities in our cafeteria.

Every child will receive a Kindergarten Readiness Handbook and a picture book.

You can drop off or pick-up a paper registration packet at Middleton or click here for the enrollment packet and process.

If you would like to complete the process on line please use the QR code.
